description: Release 1 round 5: cold-load tail of /ground-remembers on the phone (the dark style fog is off for the first frames); sorts after PG-zperf5

patches.find: map.once('style.load', () => { if (window.GTBG_PRECOMPILE) window.GTBG_PRECOMPILE(map); });   // PERF2: link the dark style's programs before its tiles arrive
patches.note: the style fog is switched off at style.load and on again at the first movement, or 4.5 s after the first idle when the visitor has not moved the map (public API only: getFog, setFog, idle, movestart, isMoving, moveend)
